## Walkthrough

Adds encryption and compression metadata handling to the File response model: two new validation rules (encryption: boolean, compression: string) and a new filter(Document) method that maps a Document's algorithm attribute to compression and derives encryption from the presence of an OpenSSL cipher attribute. Adds an end-to-end test that exercises bucket-level and per-file encryption/compression settings across upload, list, get, update, and delete operations.
